correctness: Added pure helper tests for onboarding visibility and suggestion filtering; npm test passed 11/11.
Quick-add reuses saveMemberSkill for real mode and mockStore.addMemberSkill for mock mode.
Selected-skill empty action uses the same quickAddSkill path.

Suggested skill chips add existing taxonomy skills in one click.
My Skills keeps the manual form as fallback.
Explore empty state can add the selected skill to the user's profile.
edge_cases: Suggestions exclude current user's existing member_skills.
Onboarding does not render while loading, for read-only scopes, or after the user has any skill.
Browser smoke simulated deleting all current-user skills, then quick-added a suggestion.
craft: Quick-start is compact and appears above the grid so mobile users see the action before empty Explore results.
Styling reuses Mushy tokens and restrained card/chip patterns.
Console only reported a favicon 404 during smoke.

assertions: Quick-start heading became visible after mock user skills were deleted.
